items.text: Both agent hook entry points recognize acceptance by the parsed command and arguments. Ordinary read-only commands and documentation text pass. Describe the remaining enforcement limits in the hook. Run .claude/hooks/guard-test and .codex/hooks/codex-guard-test.

For slice and exit items the prompt identifies the item number and clearly shows the exact confirmation to type. A refusal names the next step; the existing controlling-terminal requirement holds. Exercise synthetic items in scripts/refusal-test and scripts/plan-test with a shared terminal-test helper.
